ROW.COLUMN: Accounts that generate dishonored incoming checks can signal account takeover or other fraudulent activity. This scenario identifies accounts that experience incoming dishonored checks over the look-back period.

SELECT a.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID, b.ACCT_INTRL_ID, a.HH_ACCT_GRP_ID, c.NVSMT_MGR_SEQ_ID FROM @BUSINESS@.NVSMT_MGR c inner join @BUSINESS@.MANGD_ACCT b inner join @BUSINESS@.ACCT a on (b.ACCT_INTRL_ID=a.ACCT_INTRL_ID) on (c.NVSMT_MGR_INTRL_ID=b.NVSMT_MGR_INTRL_ID)

SELECT t.d_Acct_Intrl_Id , MAX(t.ACCT_SEQ_ID) ACCT_SEQ_ID , SUM(t.d_Trxn_Base_Am) d_Total_Dishonored_Amt , COUNT(1) d_Total_Dishonored_Ct , F_ROUND(((NVL(SUM(t.d_Lrf_Trxn_Am),0)/SUM(t.d_Trxn_Base_Am))*100),2) d_Lrf_Prctg , F_ROUND(((NVL(SUM(t.d_Hr_Trxn_Am),0)/SUM(t.d_Trxn_Base_Am))*100),2) d_Hr_Prctg , MAX(t.d_Efctv_Risk_Nb) d_Efctv_Risk_Nb , MAX(t.d_Actvy_Risk_Nb) d_Actvy_Risk_Nb , MAX(t.d_Data_Dump_Dt) d_Data_Dump_Dt ,(SUM(t.d_Pass_Thru_Trxn_Am)/SUM(t.d_Trxn_Base_Am))*100 d_Pass_Thru_Prctg , CASE WHEN MAX(t.d_Efctv_Risk_Nb) >= @Effctv_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl AND MAX(t.d_Actvy_Risk_Nb) >= @Actvty_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl THEN 'HR' WHEN MAX(t.D_Efctv_Risk_Nb) < @Effctv_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl AND MAX(t.d_Actvy_Risk_Nb) < @Actvty_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl THEN 'RR' ELSE 'MR' END d_Overall_Risk_Level
FROM ( SELECT A.ACCT_INTRL_ID d_Acct_Intrl_Id , A.ACCT_SEQ_ID , MI.DATA_DUMP_DT d_Data_Dump_Dt , MI.TRXN_BASE_AM d_Trxn_Base_Am , A.ACCT_EFCTV_RISK_NB d_Efctv_Risk_Nb , MI.BENEF_ACTVY_RISK_NB d_Actvy_Risk_Nb , CASE WHEN MI.BENEF_ACTVY_RISK_NB > @Actvty_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl THEN MI.TRXN_BASE_AM ELSE 0 END AS d_Hr_Trxn_Am
, CASE WHEN MI.PASS_THRU_FL = 'Y' THEN MI.TRXN_BASE_AM ELSE 0 END AS d_Pass_Thru_Trxn_Am , CASE WHEN MI.TRXN_BASE_AM - TRUNC(MI.TRXN_BASE_AM, -@Lrf_Digits) = 0 THEN MI.TRXN_BASE_AM WHEN MI.CLR_TRXN_ACTVY_AM - TRUNC(MI.CLR_TRXN_ACTVY_AM, -@Lrf_Digits) = 0 THEN MI.TRXN_BASE_AM WHEN MI.DEP_TRXN_ACTVY_AM - TRUNC(MI.DEP_TRXN_ACTVY_AM, -@Lrf_Digits) = 0 THEN MI.TRXN_BASE_AM WHEN MI.ISSUE_TRXN_ACTVY_AM - TRUNC(MI.ISSUE_TRXN_ACTVY_AM, -@Lrf_Digits) = 0 THEN MI.TRXN_BASE_AM ELSE 0 END AS d_Lrf_Trxn_Am
from @BUSINESS@.acct A , @BUSINESS@.mi_trxn MI
where MI.BENEF_ACCT_ID = A.ACCT_INTRL_ID and MI.INTRL_BENEF_ACCT_FL ='Y' and A.MANTAS_ACCT_BUS_TYPE_CD in (@Mantas_Bus_Acct_Type_Lst) and A.MANTAS_ACCT_HOLDR_TYPE_CD in ('CR','EE') and A.ACCT_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 and NVL(A.TEST_ACCT_FL,'N') <> 'Y' and ((@All_Jurisdictions_Fl = 'Y') OR (A.JRSDCN_CD IN (@Incl_Jurisdictions_Lst))) and MI.MANTAS_TRXN_ADJST_CD = 'DISHON-CHECK-IN' and MI.MANTAS_TRXN_PRDCT_CD like '%CHECK%' and MI.CXL_PAIR_TRXN_INTRL_ID is NULL and MI.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD = 'GENERAL' AND NVL(MI.TRXN_BASE_AM,0) >= @Min_Individual_Dishonored_Amt AND MI.MANTAS_POST_DT <= (SELECT MAX(KC.CLNDR_DT) FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC WHERE KC.CLNDR_NM='SYSCAL' AND KC.BUS_DAY_AGE=0) AND MI.MANTAS_POST_DT >= (SELECT MIN(KC.CLNDR_DT) FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC WHERE KC.CLNDR_NM='SYSCAL' AND KC.BUS_DAY_AGE=@Look_Back_Period-1)
UNION ALL
select A.ACCT_INTRL_ID d_Acct_Intrl_Id , A.ACCT_SEQ_ID , MI.DATA_DUMP_DT d_Data_Dump_Dt , MI.TRXN_BASE_AM d_Trxn_Base_Am , A.ACCT_EFCTV_RISK_NB d_Efctv_Risk_Nb , MI.SCND_BENEF_ACTVY_RISK_NB d_Actvy_Risk_Nb , CASE WHEN MI.SCND_BENEF_ACTVY_RISK_NB > @Actvty_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl THEN MI.TRXN_BASE_AM ELSE 0 END AS d_Hr_Trxn_Am
, CASE WHEN MI.PASS_THRU_FL = 'Y' THEN MI.TRXN_BASE_AM ELSE 0 END AS d_Pass_Thru_Trxn_Am , CASE WHEN MI.TRXN_BASE_AM - TRUNC(MI.TRXN_BASE_AM, -@Lrf_Digits) = 0 THEN MI.TRXN_BASE_AM WHEN MI.CLR_TRXN_ACTVY_AM - TRUNC(MI.CLR_TRXN_ACTVY_AM, -@Lrf_Digits) = 0 THEN MI.TRXN_BASE_AM WHEN MI.DEP_TRXN_ACTVY_AM - TRUNC(MI.DEP_TRXN_ACTVY_AM, -@Lrf_Digits) = 0 THEN MI.TRXN_BASE_AM WHEN MI.ISSUE_TRXN_ACTVY_AM - TRUNC(MI.ISSUE_TRXN_ACTVY_AM, -@Lrf_Digits) = 0 THEN MI.TRXN_BASE_AM ELSE 0 END AS d_Lrf_Trxn_Am from @BUSINESS@.acct A , @BUSINESS@.mi_trxn MI
where MI.SCND_BENEF_ACCT_ID = A.ACCT_INTRL_ID and MI.INTRL_SCND_BENEF_ACCT_FL ='Y' and A.MANTAS_ACCT_BUS_TYPE_CD in (@Mantas_Bus_Acct_Type_Lst) and A.MANTAS_ACCT_HOLDR_TYPE_CD in ('CR', 'EE') and A.ACCT_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 and NVL(A.TEST_ACCT_FL,'N') <> 'Y' and ((@All_Jurisdictions_Fl = 'Y') OR (A.JRSDCN_CD IN (@Incl_Jurisdictions_Lst))) and MI.MANTAS_TRXN_ADJST_CD = 'DISHON-CHECK-IN' and MI.MANTAS_TRXN_PRDCT_CD like '%CHECK%' and MI.CXL_PAIR_TRXN_INTRL_ID is NULL and MI.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD = 'GENERAL' AND NVL(MI.TRXN_BASE_AM,0) >= @Min_Individual_Dishonored_Amt AND MI.MANTAS_POST_DT <= (SELECT MAX(KC.CLNDR_DT) FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC WHERE KC.CLNDR_NM='SYSCAL' AND KC.BUS_DAY_AGE=0) AND MI.MANTAS_POST_DT >= (SELECT MIN(KC.CLNDR_DT) FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC WHERE KC.CLNDR_NM='SYSCAL' AND KC.BUS_DAY_AGE=@Look_Back_Period-1)
UNION ALL
select A.ACCT_INTRL_ID d_Acct_Intrl_Id , A.ACCT_SEQ_ID , MI.DATA_DUMP_DT d_Data_Dump_Dt , MI.TRXN_BASE_AM d_Trxn_Base_Am , A.ACCT_EFCTV_RISK_NB d_Efctv_Risk_Nb , MI.REM_ACTVY_RISK_NB d_Actvy_Risk_Nb , CASE WHEN MI.REM_ACTVY_RISK_NB > @Actvty_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl THEN MI.TRXN_BASE_AM ELSE 0 END AS d_Hr_Trxn_Am
, CASE WHEN MI.PASS_THRU_FL = 'Y' THEN MI.TRXN_BASE_AM ELSE 0 END AS d_Pass_Thru_Trxn_Am , CASE WHEN MI.TRXN_BASE_AM - TRUNC(MI.TRXN_BASE_AM, -@Lrf_Digits) = 0 THEN MI.TRXN_BASE_AM WHEN MI.CLR_TRXN_ACTVY_AM - TRUNC(MI.CLR_TRXN_ACTVY_AM, -@Lrf_Digits) = 0 THEN MI.TRXN_BASE_AM WHEN MI.DEP_TRXN_ACTVY_AM - TRUNC(MI.DEP_TRXN_ACTVY_AM, -@Lrf_Digits) = 0 THEN MI.TRXN_BASE_AM WHEN MI.ISSUE_TRXN_ACTVY_AM - TRUNC(MI.ISSUE_TRXN_ACTVY_AM, -@Lrf_Digits) = 0 THEN MI.TRXN_BASE_AM ELSE 0 END AS d_Lrf_Trxn_Am
from @BUSINESS@.acct A , @BUSINESS@.mi_trxn MI
where MI.REM_ACCT_ID = A.ACCT_INTRL_ID and MI.INTRL_REM_ACCT_FL ='Y' and A.MANTAS_ACCT_BUS_TYPE_CD in (@Mantas_Bus_Acct_Type_Lst) and A.MANTAS_ACCT_HOLDR_TYPE_CD in ('CR', 'EE') and A.ACCT_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 and NVL(A.TEST_ACCT_FL,'N') <> 'Y' and ((@All_Jurisdictions_Fl = 'Y') OR (A.JRSDCN_CD IN (@Incl_Jurisdictions_Lst))) and MI.MANTAS_TRXN_ADJST_CD = 'DISHON-CHECK-OUT' and MI.MANTAS_TRXN_PRDCT_CD like '%CHECK%' and MI.CXL_PAIR_TRXN_INTRL_ID is NULL and MI.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD = 'GENERAL' AND NVL(MI.TRXN_BASE_AM,0) >= @Min_Individual_Dishonored_Amt AND MI.MANTAS_ISSUE_DATE <= (SELECT MAX(KC.CLNDR_DT) FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC WHERE KC.CLNDR_NM='SYSCAL' AND KC.BUS_DAY_AGE=0) AND MI.MANTAS_ISSUE_DATE >= (SELECT MIN(KC.CLNDR_DT) FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC WHERE KC.CLNDR_NM='SYSCAL' AND KC.BUS_DAY_AGE=@Look_Back_Period-1)
) t
GROUP BY t.d_Acct_Intrl_Id HAVING (MAX(t.d_Data_Dump_Dt) >= (SELECT MIN(CLNDR_DT) FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL WHERE BUS_DAY_AGE = @Frequency_Period-1 AND CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL') AND MAX(t.d_Data_Dump_Dt) <= (SELECT MAX(CLNDR_DT) FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL WHERE BUS_DAY_AGE = 0 AND CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL')) AND (SUM(t.d_Trxn_Base_Am) >= @Min_Total_Dishonored_Amt or COUNT(1) >= @Min_Dishonored_Ct)
